fieldPolicy.canonical: Canonical Atlas data wins unless a higher-priority source provides stronger evidence and the change is explicitly reviewed.
fieldPolicy.enrichment: New fields may be proposed automatically when they do not conflict with canonical fields.
fieldPolicy.relationships: Relationships require source evidence and must be reversible.
fieldPolicy.coordinates: Never convert unknown coordinates to 0,0. Unknown coordinates remain null and are excluded from map rendering.
fieldPolicy.chronology: External chronology is advisory until validated against existing chronology and source evidence.
